reviews.x: The wig looks super real, the quality for the money is actually amazing. The wig is really thick, and overall a really good purchase for the price, I used it for a cosplay but I’m sure it can be worn for daily use.

[[VIDEOID:b405687735d0f9fa149dd7ee14580bcf]] Pros -bouncy FULL, no smell, soft, pretty curls out the pack and curls hold for the most part  Cons- shedding and doesn’t take heat.  Overall i LOVE this wig i ordered another one lol it’s very pretty and soft and i got Lots of compliments. You can’t tell it’s synthetic at all

reviews.t: Tangles after 1 week. Out the pack it is soft, long and cute.
reviews.x: Soft! Reviews were right. Tangles easily. Easy to brush and was curly straight out the pack. Wear with a headband to add the feminine touch. For a synthetic wig it does the job. Haven’t worn anywhere as yet.  *Update: Worn for 1 week and it’s safe to say it definitely tangles after a few days. Tender care to brush. You get what you pay for. It does the job if you want to wear it for a day or night out. If you can brush and untangle well then it has usuage for a month.
[[VIDEOID:fbd6e3ca5fb9e59bbeafc04adb65c3f8]] Definitely a great soft wig , super affordable you as you can see and it’s so worthy. Love my new wig 🤗
I loooooove this wig definitely will buy again. Its the perfect length. The part needs a little work nothing make up won't fix.
This wig is beautiful straight out the pack, then goes to crap. Very plastic and tangles with in the first wear, waste of money

reviews.t: Looks Great But Doesn't Hold Shape Well
reviews.x: When I first got this wig it looked perfect! But unfortunately over the last few weeks it has gotten tangled really easily and I couldn't finger brush it so now the back underside looks a little rough. I've tried wig spray and it helped but not by much. Still beautiful and the underside isn't all that visible so I think it's a great product for the price.

I love how this hair feels and looks on me, the parting looks authentic. Hair is soft, super long and wavy. I didn’t have any issues of tangling brushes through like real hair, definitely will look into more hairs from them!
This hair is beautiful I highly recommend this wig it’s so soft and full the hair line could be a little more realistic but other then that great Wig for the price absolutely love it 😍😍😍❤️❤️❤️
A great wig for a great price. It’s soft and bouncy. Great length and you can wear it alone or spice it up with a head band . Adjustable and comfortable..
This hair tangles really bad it looks ok but I wouldn’t wear it without a hat or headband because it’s hard to make it look natural. Ok wig for one day.
Look  fake but it's to late to return. The length is perfect as well as the texture but the middle part looks fake and doesn't fit well.
This wig is designed for someone with a small head. The cap has zero stretch. Once you cut the lace off your stuck with a gap.
Love love love the wig. It’s full and true to the picture. It tangles a bit but it is a good value for the money spent.

It’s a great wig for this price . Especially if you knowww what you’re doing . I’m not new to wigs at all . It feels great tho ! Of course , it tangled up a bit , but it’s synthetic so that’s expected . I just hate it has little to no lace on it . I did my real baby hairs and wore it like tht .. but again , I’m not new to this . So if you know what you’re doing , definitely purchase it . If you don’t , you might want to find another product .

5 out of 5 I bought this wig for my Jamaican trip because i kno i was going to be running around for the first week and a half in planning my sisters funeral , and trust me this baby did what she needs to do ❤️ Then I didn’t wanna get rid of her after so i just cut it into a bob and babbbbyyyyy it was a brand new wig all over again i cant wait to purchase another one.

Out of the package it was immediately obvious this was not going to be a keeper. The hair was too shiny and felt like plastic (clearly a $27 wig). It was rough feeling at the very top and tangled like mad just getting it out of the package. The length also seemed shorter than 28”. It did have good density, just poor quality hair. I won’t buy this brand again.

reviews.t: Take the risk, it’s worth it!
reviews.x: I wanted to to try something new, so I found and ordered this wig. The softness is awesome, the fit is perfect and adjustable, the look is just the right amount of extra without being too over the top for me. I 100% recommended, I’d also suggest you carry a small brush or wide tooth comb because it is synthetic. Worth every penny.

WTF.. is this .. this straight out he box ....YES l know you get what you pay for  but if l wanted  a party city wig .l would have went there .. l at least  throught  it would be  beauty supply store value you .. very upset .. wait of money has is so tangled  and when I lightly brush shedding like crazy ... yeah ..uh no...

reviews.t: Super cute, love the body wave!
reviews.x: GIRRRLL! THIS HAIR IS SO NICE!! I was shocked at how nice it was because of the fact that it's synthetic. But it's definitely worth it. It does get a little tangly, but nothing too crazy. I love the body wave on it, it's beautiful and soft. I would recommend it!  For a full review search "Nakia Reviews" on YouTube!

reviews.t: I'm shocked at how happy I am!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:fc604696fbe3300bfdeb9220bd8803e0]] This synthetic wig has blown my mind. I never wear synthetic but I wanted something different. This wig looks so real and you feel fabulous when you where it! No chemical smell and easy to manage. Not too thick. Great value.

Pretty wig for being synthetic. The hair is really soft and isn’t too shiny and fake looking. The part/scalp area isn’t very realistic but I was using this wig for a costume. It tangled but not as bad as other synthetic wigs and was tangles were easily removed.

I was a bit disappointed when I received it. I felt like it didn’t look like what’s on the model. Even after I manipulated it and roller set it. It also tangles and sheds very easily. For the amount I paid, I can’t be upset I only got one wear out of it.

This hair was very shiny, very thin, and didn’t completely look like the model.  I’ve bought synthetic wigs at the local beat supply store that honestly were cheaper, but better quality.  It could’ve been a bad batch of wigs. It just wasn’t for me!

I took a picture to upload but I won't give Amazon access to my photos. Shed a little and gets tangled but so worth the money. The texture of the hair is smooth, the length is amazing and the curl pattern is awesome 😎 I look so fly with this piece.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as soft and full, especially for the price.
Many reviewers note that the wig tangles easily, sometimes within days of wear.
Several reviewers say it looks natural or realistic, though a few find the parting or hairline looks fake.
Some reviewers report shedding and that the wig does not take heat well.
A few reviewers complain about fit issues, including a small, non-stretchy cap and little to no lace.
